_purpose: JUDGEMENT layer, deliberately separate from data/audit/dossiers.json which holds only quoted findings. Rated for one goal: reaching 18/30 by drilling past papers. Override freely.

_rubric.1: Solved past papers for many sessions, single assessment, no gate beyond 18 overall.
_rubric.2: Past papers or samples exist; one straightforward written or coursework assessment.
_rubric.3: Either no published papers, or two components to satisfy, or a large syllabus (12 CFU).
_rubric.4: Independent pass gates, negative marking, or a compulsory oral on top of a written part.
_rubric.5: Rules not published anywhere reachable, or several gates at once; cannot be drilled blind.
